english.title: Falsify / conceal / destroy documents relevant to investigation by SFO /OFT into offence under s, 188
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), knowing or suspecting that an investigation by the Serious Fraud Office or the Office of Fair Trading into a cartel offence under section 188 of the Enterprise Act 2002 was being or was likely to have been carried out,

(A)_[falsified]_
(B)_[concealed]_
(C)_[destroyed]_
(D)_[disposed of]_

documents, namely **(..SPECIFY DOCUMENTS..), which you knew or suspected were or would be relevant to that investigation

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Five years Imprisonment and /or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
